mapper.select: SELECT #{scheduleDate} as SCHEDULE_DATE, g.ENTRUST_MIX_AREA, g.ENTRUSTED_MIX_AREA, t.MATERIAL_NAME, t.total_plan_qty total_Send_Qty, t.MID_PLAN_QTY as MID_SEND_QTY, t.MID_EXPECT_START_TIME as MID_EXPECT_DEMAND_TIME, t.NIGHT_PLAN_QTY as NIGHT_SEND_QTY, t.NIGHT_EXPECT_START_TIME as NIGHT_EXPECT_DEMAND_TIME, t.DAY_PLAN_QTY as DAY_SEND_QTY, t.DAY_EXPECT_START_TIME as DAY_EXPECT_DEMAND_TIME, now() as SEND_TIME, t.ID as SCHEDULE_ID FROM T_LHFL_SPAN_SETTING g INNER JOIN T_MATERIAL_SCHEDULE_RESULT t ON g.ENTRUST_MIX_AREA = t.MIX_AREA AND g.MATERIAL_NAME = t.MATERIAL_NAME WHERE g.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND t.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND t.MIX_AREA = #{mixArea} AND t.SCHEDULE_DATE = #{scheduleDate} AND t.MATERIAL_NAME NOT IN (SELECT MATERIAL_NAME FROM T_MATERIAL_SPAN_RECEIVE WHERE DEL_FLAG = '0' AND ENTRUST_MIX_AREA = #{mixArea} /*委托的密炼区*/ AND IS_AUTO = '0' /**硫磺辅料自动排的时候生成的跨区记录**/ AND RECEIVE_STATUS = '1' /*已接受*/ AND SCHEDULE_DATE = #{scheduleDate} ) /*过滤掉 自动排创建跨区发送记录已经被接收的 物料*/
